items.title: The Real Cost of a Single Insert in Postgres | Tiger Data
items.summary: Postgres writes a separate WAL record for each row in an insert, with a log size of roughly 345 bytes per 40-byte row. Index maintenance adds to the log size, but not data. The cost of an insert is measured by the number of WAL records and the log size.
